module.purpose: Provides an adapter that converts Next.js server-side rendering results into App Router navigation behavior.
module.summary: This module wraps a server-side props resolver and executes it asynchronously with a Next.js request context. Redirect and not-found results are translated into App Router control-flow helpers, while successful props—including promise-based props—are normalized into a returned object.
module.businessContext: Supports migration or interoperability between Pages Router SSR handlers and the App Router. Failures can produce incorrect redirects, missing-page responses, or lost page properties.
functions: withAppDirSsr (~L4-21): Adapts server-side props results to App Router responses

io: Invokes Next.js redirect navigation when the SSR response contains a redirect.
Invokes Next.js not-found navigation when the SSR response contains notFound.

moduleContractTests.rationale: The wrapper must normalize synchronous and asynchronous props without retaining the response envelope.

moduleContractTests.scenario: The wrapped server-side props function returns a redirect response.
moduleContractTests.then: redirect is invoked with "/login" and no props result is returned
moduleContractTests.rationale: Redirect responses must be handed to the App Router navigation boundary.

moduleContractTests.scenario: The wrapped server-side props function returns a not-found response.
moduleContractTests.then: notFound is invoked and no props result is returned
moduleContractTests.rationale: Not-found responses must be handed to the App Router not-found boundary.
